translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Horo mbiru hayagola Naiomi ibugua Ludihondo lalu, Dindini bayuwa walime agali heba biragadagua birabelo agali mbira tai bulene horo hayada.

Agali Boasa biago ibunaga bali mabuni ibunaga biabe biaga waliru baba biabe bialu harigo agali o biago inanaga damenego manda bideni. I̱na bi mbira languleberogo bayuwa hale habe, lene. Ayu mbiraga haragola ibuni bali iraneru lini hondo ibira ibira bilo bo taulalu holebirago

í̠ni tingini wayawaya babe. Wayawaya bowa weli ngabi ha̱i̱ habe. Ani buwa aga debenebi bayuwa bibe. Ani bialu bal iraneru lini hondo ibira ibira bilo bo taulalu kagoha puwa í̠ kalo manda nabilo ha do howa habe. Ibugua biai howa hina ibaru nelo henge mu habe.
Nai halu palirago agoha yagidabe bayuwa handabe. Ibu padagoha puwa ibunaga balangiya geha yagi miale howa ogoniha palibe. Ani beregola ibunime au bibe lalu mani langulebirago, lene.
Ludi ibugua ladai bialu lalu, Í̠na laregodaguaore biagua, lene.
Ani lowa Ludi ibu arunime bibe layadagua biai halu bali bo taulalu hearia pene.

Boasa ibugua hina ibaru nayagola howa hongo halu dungu lene. Hongo halu dungu leagola bali halu hengedo wiaru yaa̱i̱ na̱i̱ buwa palene. Ani biagola Ludi ibu hendeore ge hogorale bialu puwa Boasanaga balangiya yi heago miale howa paleagoha hendeore gehayagi palene.
Mbi hanuni agima Boasa palu beregedalu howa handalu hearia waliore ibu geha yagi íbu paleneyane mogolo hendene.

Hondowa ibugua hale halu lalu, O padago aibe, lene. Ani hale hayagola Ludi ibugua ladai bialu lalu, Í̠naga biabe bia haga i̱ Ludi padogoni. I̱naga dameneru hondo haga í̠ kegonigo i̱ dabu bibelo hame ledo, lene.

Ani layagola Boasa ibugua lalu, Anduane Homogo ibugua í̠ mo turuore helo. Í̠na í̠ arunihondo birigobi ndo áyu i̱hondo í̠na mana debeneore bulene manda birida. Homogoyaguabi yagibanoyaguabi igiri ale hondolene waharida.
Ludi-o í̠ mini dege dindi holeni. Bibahende ogoria karume í̠ore wali bayaore ledago. I̱na í̠na bia laregoore biai holebero.
I̱na í̠ damene hondo holeneha kogonigo agali mbira í̠ handaya ho holene mbira kago ogonihondo henge ala mibehego

áyu mbiraga eberegoniha palibe. Egerebagi haragola damene biagome bulene ngadagua bero larabe be au larabe hondoliya. Ibugua í̠ hondo holiya layagua nde baya gibiore lolebira. Nabule layagua nde Anduane Homogonaga minini howa larogo dameneme hondo holene mana ngadagua bulene i̱naga ngago bulebero. Áyu ogoniha gao lelo palibe, lene.

Ani layagola Ludi ibugua Boasanaga ge wiagohayagi palenego egerebagiore Boasahanda layadagua wali agalime de nahendelo manda buwa ohalu abale heyabe layadagua abale pole heyini. Boasa ibugua wali agalime Ludi ibu paleagoha íbu palialu piyadalo manda nabilo ani lene.

Heyayagola Boasa ibugua lalu, Í̠na aga ogoriani dungu ha. Ludi ibugua ani biyagola Boasahanda bali lini biaru nu kira (20) kilo agima ale mo ya hene. Ludi henelo ibugua mo yaraga haya handala hanalu Bedeleheme tano dai bini.
Dai biyagola ibu aruni Naiomi ibugua, I̱ wane-o, lowa, Bia agua biyabe, lalu hale hene. Ani layagola Ludi ibugua Boasahanda layarubi biyarubi bibahende lamiai hene.
Ibugua lamaro bialu lalu, Boasa ibugua í̠ bederia bame gi walambo nadaibi lole lowa bali lini hilu hombedo ngiyadaruni, lene.

Naiomi ibugua Ludihondo lalu, Ai mini dege dindi nahe ema nabi hendeore birabe. O biragoni bialu au biatagi harabe hondole. Boasa ibugua mo tiga au bibehedabe hondole hariga hai bialu hangu kane. Hariga mbira handa walia haradagua ibu ha̱lo̱ holebira, lene.
